title: Dropper Rename
description: This mod allows you to rename items using the dropper!
body:
Have you ever wanted to automate the renaming of items? Well, this mod is for you! This mod allows you to rename items using the dropper.

To rename items, rename the dropper block on anvil. After that, all the items that will be skipped/thrown through this dropper will be renamed.

This mod is completely server-side and does not require installation on the client when installed on the server.
